Some horror authors become the perfect scribes for a particular age. Enter Nat Cassidy whose work is full of existential inquiry and dread, people coping with fundamental change, reality falling apart, good old fashioned insanity and utter, utter, terror… and if that isn’t the best description of the 2020s then I’ll be damned if I know […]
